capabilities: Highlight, mark regions and drop sticky notes in PDFs via a built-in pdf.js viewer
Wrap selections in notes with anchor tags and attach annotations
Ask an OpenAI-compatible model about a selection, with follow-up exchanges kept per annotation
Browse, filter, rebind and batch-delete all vault annotations in an index sidebar
Define prompt templates as Markdown files with variables and frontmatter overrides
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; main.js is ~3.8 MB because pdf.js fonts and CMap tables are inlined, and full settings docs live in a separate Chinese README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to annotate selections in notes and PDFs without modifying the source, and no way to ask a model about a selection in place.

relations.evidence: Bundles pdf.js (pdfjs-dist@4.10.38, Apache-2.0) for PDF rendering
handlers that want it can point Dataview at the plugin folder

summary: Annotation plugin that highlights, tags and asks AI questions about selected text in notes and PDFs, storing each annotation as its own linked Markdown file.
